---
title: "Shared mutations across strains: gene hits and loci"
author: "Gresham Lab"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: hide
params:
  vcf_dir: "."                 # folder with the *.ann.vcf files (default: same folder as this Rmd)
  vcf_pattern: "\\.ann\\.vcf$" # which files to read
  strain_suffix: "_filtered_snps_2\\.ann\\.vcf$"  # stripped from file names to get strain names
  pass_only: true              # TRUE = keep only FILTER == PASS calls
  include_upstream: false      # TRUE = also count upstream (promoter) variants as hits to that gene
  exclude_synonymous: false    # TRUE = ignore synonymous variants
  min_strains: 2               # a gene / locus must be in at least this many strains to be plotted
  max_strains: .inf            # cap, e.g. 41, to hide hits shared by every strain (likely background vs. reference)
  top_n: 50                    # how many genes / loci to show in the ranked bar charts
  ancestor_file: "H5NKTDRX3_3183_filtered_snps_2.ann.vcf"  # ancestral strain for section 3
  ancestor_use_all_calls: true # TRUE = mask every ancestral SNP, even ones that failed a filter
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
```

## Overview

This report reads every SnpEff-annotated VCF in the folder, treats each file as one
strain, and asks two questions:

1. **Gene level** – which genes carry a mutation in more than one strain? A gene is
   counted once per strain, no matter how many SNPs that strain has in it.
2. **Locus level** – which exact variants (chromosome, position, REF>ALT) occur in more
   than one strain?

For each, there is a frequency-distribution plot, a ranked bar chart of the most
shared genes/loci (hover to see strains), and a searchable table listing the strains
carrying each hit. The tables are also written to CSV next to this file.

Section 3 repeats the analysis for the evolved strains only: the ancestral strain is
dropped and every SNP present in the ancestor is removed, so what remains are mutations
that arose after the ancestor.

**Current settings:** PASS only = `r params$pass_only`;
upstream variants counted as gene hits = `r params$include_upstream`;
synonymous excluded = `r params$exclude_synonymous`.

## Read the VCFs

```{r read}
vcf_files <- list.files(params$vcf_dir, pattern = params$vcf_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot("No VCF files found - check params$vcf_dir" = length(vcf_files) > 0)

ann_fields <- c("Allele", "Effect", "Impact", "Gene_Name", "Gene_ID", "Feature_Type",
                "Feature_ID", "Biotype", "Rank", "HGVS_c", "HGVS_p")

read_ann_vcf <- function(f) {
  lines <- readLines(f)
  lines <- lines[!startsWith(lines, "#")]
  if (length(lines) == 0) return(NULL)
  cols <- str_split_fixed(lines, "\t", 10)
  tibble(
    strain = sub(params$strain_suffix, "", basename(f)),
    CHROM  = cols[, 1],
    POS    = as.integer(cols[, 2]),
    REF    = cols[, 4],
    ALT    = cols[, 5],
    QUAL   = as.numeric(cols[, 6]),
    FILTER = cols[, 7],
    ANN    = str_match(cols[, 8], "ANN=([^;]+)")[, 2],
    GT     = sub(":.*", "", cols[, 10])
  )
}

variants <- map_dfr(vcf_files, read_ann_vcf) %>%
  filter(!GT %in% c("0", "0/0", "0|0", "./.", ".")) # drop reference / no-call genotypes

strains <- sort(unique(variants$strain))
total_strains <- length(strains)

variants %>% count(strain, name = "all_calls") %>%
  left_join(variants %>% filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>% count(strain, name = "PASS_calls"),
            by = "strain") %>%
  datatable(caption = "Calls per strain (before filtering)", rownames = FALSE,
            options = list(pageLength = 10))

if (params$pass_only) variants <- filter(variants, FILTER == "PASS")
variants <- variants %>% mutate(locus = paste0(CHROM, ":", POS, ":", REF, ">", ALT))
```

`r total_strains` strains, `r nrow(variants)` variant calls after filtering.

```{r annotations}
# One row per (variant call x SnpEff annotation)
ann_long <- variants %>%
  mutate(ann_entry = str_split(ANN, ",")) %>%
  unnest(ann_entry)
ann_mat <- str_split_fixed(ann_long$ann_entry, "\\|", 12)[, 1:11, drop = FALSE]
colnames(ann_mat) <- ann_fields
ann_long <- bind_cols(select(ann_long, -ann_entry, -ANN), as_tibble(ann_mat))

# Which effects count as "this gene is mutated"
non_genic <- c("intergenic_region", "downstream_gene_variant")
if (!params$include_upstream) non_genic <- c(non_genic, "upstream_gene_variant")

gene_hits <- ann_long %>%
  filter(!Effect %in% non_genic, Gene_Name != "")
if (params$exclude_synonymous) gene_hits <- filter(gene_hits, Effect != "synonymous_variant")
```

## 1. Gene-level hits

```{r gene_table}
gene_summary <- gene_hits %>%
  distinct(strain, Gene_Name, Gene_ID, locus, Effect, HGVS_p) %>%
  group_by(Gene_Name, Gene_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_strains      = n_distinct(strain),
    pct_strains    = round(100 * n_strains / total_strains, 1),
    n_distinct_loci = n_distinct(locus),
    effects        = paste(sort(unique(Effect)), collapse = "; "),
    protein_changes = paste(sort(unique(HGVS_p[HGVS_p != ""])), collapse = "; "),
    strains        = paste(sort(unique(strain)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_strains), desc(n_distinct_loci), Gene_Name)
```

### Frequency distribution

How many genes are mutated in exactly *k* strains?

```{r gene_hist, fig.height=4}
gene_dist <- gene_summary %>% count(n_strains, name = "n_genes")
p <- ggplot(gene_dist, aes(n_strains, n_genes,
                           text = paste0(n_genes, " genes mutated in ", n_strains, " strain(s)"))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3B6FB6") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(total_strains)) +
  labs(x = "Number of strains in which the gene is mutated", y = "Number of genes") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

### Most frequently hit genes

Genes mutated in at least `r params$min_strains` (and at most `r params$max_strains`) strains (top `r params$top_n`).
Hover a bar to see the strains.

```{r gene_bar, fig.height=max(4, 0.22 * min(params$top_n, sum(gene_summary$n_strains >= params$min_strains & gene_summary$n_strains <= params$max_strains)) + 1.5)}
top_genes <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(n_strains >= params$min_strains, n_strains <= params$max_strains) %>%
  slice_head(n = params$top_n) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(Gene_Name == Gene_ID, Gene_Name, paste0(Gene_Name, " (", Gene_ID, ")")),
         label = factor(label, levels = rev(unique(label))))

p <- ggplot(top_genes, aes(n_strains, label,
                           text = paste0("<b>", label, "</b><br>", n_strains, " strains, ",
                                         n_distinct_loci, " distinct loci<br>",
                                         str_wrap(strains, 60) %>% str_replace_all("\n", "<br>")))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3B6FB6") +
  labs(x = "Number of strains", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

### Gene table

```{r gene_dt}
datatable(gene_summary, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
          colnames = c("Gene", "Gene ID", "# strains", "% strains", "# distinct loci",
                       "Effects", "Protein changes", "Strains"),
          options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE,
                         columnDefs = list(list(width = "400px", targets = 7))))
write.csv(gene_summary, file.path(params$vcf_dir, "gene_hit_frequency.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## 2. Locus-level hits

Each locus is one exact variant (`CHROM:POS:REF>ALT`), labelled with its most severe
SnpEff annotation.

```{r locus_table}
# SnpEff lists the most severe annotation first
top_ann <- ann_long %>% group_by(locus) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(locus, Effect, Impact, Gene_Name, Gene_ID, HGVS_c, HGVS_p)

locus_scope <- variants %>%
  semi_join(if (params$exclude_synonymous)
              filter(top_ann, Effect != "synonymous_variant") else top_ann, by = "locus")

locus_summary <- locus_scope %>%
  group_by(locus, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT) %>%
  summarise(
    n_strains   = n_distinct(strain),
    pct_strains = round(100 * n_strains / total_strains, 1),
    genotypes   = paste(sort(unique(GT)), collapse = ", "),
    strains     = paste(sort(unique(strain)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(top_ann, by = "locus") %>%
  select(locus, CHROM, POS, Gene_Name, Gene_ID, Effect, Impact, HGVS_c, HGVS_p,
         n_strains, pct_strains, genotypes, strains) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_strains), CHROM, POS)
```

### Frequency distribution

How many loci are shared by exactly *k* strains?

```{r locus_hist, fig.height=4}
locus_dist <- locus_summary %>% count(n_strains, name = "n_loci")
p <- ggplot(locus_dist, aes(n_strains, n_loci,
                            text = paste0(n_loci, " loci found in ", n_strains, " strain(s)"))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#C2563A") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(total_strains)) +
  labs(x = "Number of strains carrying the variant", y = "Number of loci") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

### Most frequently shared loci

Loci present in at least `r params$min_strains` (and at most `r params$max_strains`) strains (top `r params$top_n`).
Hover a bar to see the strains.

```{r locus_bar, fig.height=max(4, 0.22 * min(params$top_n, sum(locus_summary$n_strains >= params$min_strains & locus_summary$n_strains <= params$max_strains)) + 1.5)}
top_loci <- locus_summary %>%
  filter(n_strains >= params$min_strains, n_strains <= params$max_strains) %>%
  slice_head(n = params$top_n) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(locus, "  ", Gene_Name, ifelse(HGVS_p != "", paste0(" ", HGVS_p), "")),
         label = factor(label, levels = rev(unique(label))))

p <- ggplot(top_loci, aes(n_strains, label, fill = Impact,
                          text = paste0("<b>", locus, "</b> ", Gene_Name, " ", HGVS_p, "<br>",
                                        Effect, "<br>", n_strains, " strains<br>",
                                        str_wrap(strains, 60) %>% str_replace_all("\n", "<br>")))) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(HIGH = "#B2182B", MODERATE = "#EF8A62",
                               LOW = "#67A9CF", MODIFIER = "#999999")) +
  labs(x = "Number of strains", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

### Locus table

```{r locus_dt}
datatable(locus_summary, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
          colnames = c("Locus", "Chr", "Pos", "Gene", "Gene ID", "Effect", "Impact",
                       "HGVS.c", "HGVS.p", "# strains", "% strains", "Genotypes", "Strains"),
          options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE,
                         columnDefs = list(list(width = "400px", targets = 12))))
write.csv(locus_summary, file.path(params$vcf_dir, "locus_frequency.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## 3. Evolved strains only (ancestral SNPs removed)

The ancestral strain (`r params$ancestor_file`) is left out, and every locus
(`CHROM:POS:REF>ALT`) called in the ancestor is removed from all other strains.
`ancestor_use_all_calls = ` `r params$ancestor_use_all_calls`: when `TRUE`, the mask
includes ancestral calls that failed a GATK filter. This avoids counting a background SNP
as new just because it failed a filter in the ancestor but passed in an evolved strain.
`max_strains` is not applied here because shared background has already been removed.

```{r anc_mask}
anc_path <- file.path(params$vcf_dir, params$ancestor_file)
stopifnot("Ancestor VCF not found - check params$ancestor_file" = file.exists(anc_path))
anc_strain <- sub(params$strain_suffix, "", basename(anc_path))

anc_calls <- read_ann_vcf(anc_path) %>%
  filter(!GT %in% c("0", "0/0", "0|0", "./.", "."))
if (!params$ancestor_use_all_calls) anc_calls <- filter(anc_calls, FILTER == "PASS")
anc_loci <- unique(paste0(anc_calls$CHROM, ":", anc_calls$POS, ":", anc_calls$REF, ">", anc_calls$ALT))

evo_variants <- variants %>% filter(strain != anc_strain, !locus %in% anc_loci)
evo_strains  <- setdiff(strains, anc_strain)
evo_total    <- length(evo_strains)

tibble(strain = evo_strains) %>%
  left_join(variants %>% filter(strain != anc_strain) %>% count(strain, name = "calls_before_mask"),
            by = "strain") %>%
  left_join(evo_variants %>% count(strain, name = "calls_after_mask"), by = "strain") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("calls"), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L))) %>%
  datatable(caption = paste0("Calls per evolved strain before / after removing the ",
                             length(anc_loci), " ancestral loci"),
            rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10))
```

`r evo_total` evolved strains, `r nrow(evo_variants)` variant calls left after masking
`r length(anc_loci)` ancestral loci.

```{r evo_tables}
evo_gene_summary <- gene_hits %>%
  semi_join(evo_variants, by = c("strain", "locus")) %>%
  distinct(strain, Gene_Name, Gene_ID, locus, Effect, HGVS_p) %>%
  group_by(Gene_Name, Gene_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_strains       = n_distinct(strain),
    pct_strains     = round(100 * n_strains / evo_total, 1),
    n_distinct_loci = n_distinct(locus),
    effects         = paste(sort(unique(Effect)), collapse = "; "),
    protein_changes = paste(sort(unique(HGVS_p[HGVS_p != ""])), collapse = "; "),
    strains         = paste(sort(unique(strain)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_strains), desc(n_distinct_loci), Gene_Name)

evo_locus_summary <- evo_variants %>%
  semi_join(if (params$exclude_synonymous)
              filter(top_ann, Effect != "synonymous_variant") else top_ann, by = "locus") %>%
  group_by(locus, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT) %>%
  summarise(
    n_strains   = n_distinct(strain),
    pct_strains = round(100 * n_strains / evo_total, 1),
    genotypes   = paste(sort(unique(GT)), collapse = ", "),
    strains     = paste(sort(unique(strain)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(top_ann, by = "locus") %>%
  select(locus, CHROM, POS, Gene_Name, Gene_ID, Effect, Impact, HGVS_c, HGVS_p,
         n_strains, pct_strains, genotypes, strains) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_strains), CHROM, POS)

write.csv(evo_gene_summary,  file.path(params$vcf_dir, "gene_hit_frequency_no_ancestor.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(evo_locus_summary, file.path(params$vcf_dir, "locus_frequency_no_ancestor.csv"),    row.names = FALSE)

n_evo_gene_bars  <- min(params$top_n, sum(evo_gene_summary$n_strains  >= params$min_strains))
n_evo_locus_bars <- min(params$top_n, sum(evo_locus_summary$n_strains >= params$min_strains))
```

### 3a. Gene-level hits: frequency distribution

```{r evo_gene_hist, fig.height=4}
p <- evo_gene_summary %>% count(n_strains, name = "n_genes") %>%
  ggplot(aes(n_strains, n_genes,
             text = paste0(n_genes, " genes mutated in ", n_strains, " strain(s)"))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3B6FB6") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(evo_total)) +
  labs(x = "Number of evolved strains in which the gene is mutated", y = "Number of genes") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

### 3a. Most frequently hit genes

Genes mutated in at least `r params$min_strains` evolved strains (top `r params$top_n`).
Hover a bar to see the strains.

```{r evo_gene_bar, fig.height=max(4, 0.22 * n_evo_gene_bars + 1.5)}
if (n_evo_gene_bars == 0) {
  cat("No gene is mutated in", params$min_strains, "or more evolved strains.")
} else {
  top <- evo_gene_summary %>%
    filter(n_strains >= params$min_strains) %>%
    slice_head(n = params$top_n) %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(Gene_Name == Gene_ID, Gene_Name, paste0(Gene_Name, " (", Gene_ID, ")")),
           label = factor(label, levels = rev(unique(label))))
  p <- ggplot(top, aes(n_strains, label,
                       text = paste0("<b>", label, "</b><br>", n_strains, " strains, ",
                                     n_distinct_loci, " distinct loci<br>",
                                     str_wrap(strains, 60) %>% str_replace_all("\n", "<br>")))) +
    geom_col(fill = "#3B6FB6") +
    labs(x = "Number of evolved strains", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
}
```

## Notes

- Variants found in (nearly) all strains are most likely differences between your
  ancestral background and the S288C reference rather than independently acquired
  mutations; filter on `# strains` in the tables to focus on intermediate frequencies.
- Only files directly in `vcf_dir` are read; subfolders (e.g. `GAP1strains/`) are ignored.
- Strain names are taken from the file names with `_filtered_snps_2.ann.vcf` removed.
